patthana24.11:1.1: na appaccayaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sappaccayo hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekaṃ. na appaccayaṃ na nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sappaccayo
patthana24.11:2.1: nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekaṃ. saṅkhataṃ sappaccayasadisaṃ.
patthana24.11:3.1: nasanidassanaduka nahetuduke sanidassanaduka hetudukaṃ na sanidassanaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassano hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana24.11:4.1: na sanidassanaṃ na nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassano nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. nasappaṭighaduka nahetuduke sappaṭighaduka hetudukaṃ
patthana24.11:5.1: na sappaṭighaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca appaṭigho hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana24.11:6.1: na sappaṭighaṃ na nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sappaṭigho nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. narūpīduka nahetuduke rūpīduka hetudukaṃ
patthana24.11:7.1: na rūpiṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca arūpī hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana24.11:8.1: na rūpiṃ na nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca arūpī nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. gaṇitakena tīṇi. nalokiyaduka nahetuduke lokiyaduka hetudukaṃ
patthana24.11:9.1: na lokiyaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca lokuttaro hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana24.11:10.1: na lokuttaraṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca lokiyo hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ. hetuyā dve.
patthana24.11:11.1: na lokiyaṃ na nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca lokiyo nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana24.11:12.1: na lokuttaraṃ na nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca lokiyo nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ. hetuyā cattāri. nakenaciviññeyyaduka nahetuduke kenaciviññeyyaduka hetudukaṃ
patthana24.11:13.1: na kenaciviññeyyaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kenaciviññeyyo hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā nava.
patthana24.11:14.1: na kenaciviññeyyaṃ na nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kenacinaviññeyyo nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā nava. noāsavaduka nahetuduke āsavaduka hetudukaṃ
